items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Ein Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats zu erheben; der Tag, an dem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben wird, zählt dabei nicht mit.
items.computation: The letter is dated Fri 2 Apr 2027 and was sent by ordinary post, so under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO it counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Tue 6 Apr 2027. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO the day of delivery itself does not count, so the one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) starts on Wed 7 Apr 2027 and would end, per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, on Thu 6 May 2027. That day is Christi Himmelfahrt, a public holiday in Schleswig-Holstein (and nationwide), so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deadline shifts to the next business day, Fri 7 May 2027.
